chunks: The angels said: "O Mary, indeed God has favoured you and made you immaculate, and chosen you from all the women of the world."
ai.seo_question: What did the angels say to Maryam regarding her selection by God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked with the subsequent verse (3:43) to emphasize Maryam's unique status as 'Sayyidah' (Lady) and her spiritual purity (Taharah) from both minor and major sins (Ismah). The angels' proclamation underscores her selection not only for her piety but also for her role in the miraculous birth of Isa (Jesus), establishing a precedent for the elevated status of the Ahl al-Bayt in Islamic theology.
